mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id,product_id,product_type,problem_quantity,problem_drawing, user_id, duty_id, type, remark, quality_type, status
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.id 'project.id', c.name 'project.name', c.short_name 'project.short_name', c.serial_number 'project.serial_number', c.`name` project_name, d.`name` user_name, e.`name` duty_name, area.`name` areaName, mbf.`name` factory_name, mbw.`name` workshop_name, mbpl.`name` production_line_name, mbp.`name` processName, pl.`name` monomer_name, qco.name levelOneName, qcc.name levelTwoName, qcc.penalty, qcc.behavior_score FROM mes_building_qhse b LEFT JOIN contract_project c ON b.project_id = c.id AND c.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pl ON b.monomer_id = pl.id AND pl.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON b.area_id=area.id AND area.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON b.user_id = d.id AND d.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN sys_user e ON b.duty_id = e.id AND e.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON b.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON b.workshop_id = mbw.id AND mbw.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line mbpl ON b.production_line_id = mbpl.id AND mbpl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON b.process_id = mbp.id AND mbp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_quality_class_config qco on b.level_one_type = qco.id and qco.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_quality_class_config qcc on b.level_two_type = qcc.id and qcc.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE b.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND b.id = #{id};
select type, count(*) quantity from mes_building_qhse where date_format(create_time, '%Y') = #{year} and bool_delete_enum = 0 group by type
SELECT COUNT(*) quantity FROM mes_building_qhse WHERE type & #{type} AND bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time , '%Y')= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime} , '%Y')
SELECT * FROM mes_building_qhse WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND type & #{type} AND DATE_FORMAT( create_time , '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime} , '%Y' )
SELECT id,qhse_report_id,inspection_report_id FROM mes_building_qhse WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0

select ifnull(count(a.quality_type), 0) from mes_building_qhse a where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.type = 1 and FIND_IN_SET( #{value}, a.quality_type )
and a.project_id = #{projectId}
and date_format(a.create_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m')
and date_format(a.create_time,'%Y-%m') = date_format(DATE_SUB(curdate(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m')
and date_format(a.create_time,'%Y') = date_format(now(),'%Y-%m')

select a.time as date, sum(IFNULL(problem_quantity,0)) quantity from ( select MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + interval months.seq MONTH as time from (select @seq := @seq + 1 as seq from information_schema.columns,(select @seq := -1) tmp limit 12) months) a left join mes_building_qhse qhse on DATE_FORMAT(qhse.create_time,'%Y-%m')= DATE_FORMAT(a.time,'%Y-%m') and process_id = #{processId} and qhse.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_team_user_link link on qhse.team_id = link.team_id and link.user_id = #{userId} and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 where (YEAR(qhse.create_time)= #{year} or qhse.create_time is null) GROUP BY a.time

SELECT * FROM mes_building_qhse WHERE
( product_id= #{number.productId} and number=#{number.number})
and bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT art.serial_number, qhse.number FROM mes_building_package_number_link link INNER JOIN mes_building_qhse qhse ON link.product_id = qhse.product_id AND link.number = qhse.number AND qhse.`status` = 1 AND qhse.type = 8 AND qhse.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact art ON qhse.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND link.product_type = 2 AND link.package_id in
#{packageId}

select qhse.id, qhse.qhse_number, qhse.problem_drawing, qhse.drawing_label, cp.serial_number projectSerialNumber, cp.short_name projectShortName, case when qhse.task_type_enum = 2 then ta.serial_number when qhse.task_type_enum = 16 then ass.serial_number end as serial_number, su.`name` inspectionName, qhse.create_time inspectionDate, su2.`name` username, pro.`name` processName, ccone.NAME levelOneName, cctwo.NAME levelTwoName, cctwo.behavior_score behaviorScore, cctwo.penalty penalty, qhse.status from mes_building_qhse qhse left join contract_project cp on qhse.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_artifact ta on qhse.product_id = ta.id and ta.bool_delete_enum = 0 and qhse.task_type_enum = 2 left join tech_assemble ass on qhse.product_id = ass.id and ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 and qhse.task_type_enum = 16 left join sys_user su on qhse.user_id = su.id and su.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user su2 on qhse.duty_id = su2.id and su2.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_safety_class_config ccone ON ccone.id = qhse.level_one_type AND ccone.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_safety_class_config cctwo ON cctwo.id = qhse.level_two_type AND cctwo.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_process pro on qhse.process_id = pro.id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 where qhse.type IN (2, 4) and qhse.duty_id = #{userId}
and DATE_FORMAT(qhse.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', pm.`name` 'monomerName', area.`name` 'areaName', pro.task_type_enum, CASE pro.task_type_enum WHEN 2 THEN art.serial_number WHEN 16 THEN ass.serial_number END serial_number, CASE pro.task_type_enum WHEN 2 THEN art.id WHEN 16 THEN ass.id END productId, pro.id 'taskProcessId', rep.quantity inspectionQuantity, tulink.user_name 'team.name', shop.`name` 'workshopName', pss.`name` 'processName', rep.report_time 'reportDate', rep.inspection_time 'passageTime', rep.number 'number' FROM mes_building_produce_team_report rep inner JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON rep.task_process_id = pro.id and rep.product_id = pro.product_id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON pro.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pro.monomer_id = pm.id AND pm.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON pro.area_id = area.id AND area.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON pro.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pro.task_type_enum = 2 LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON pro.product_id = ass.id AND ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pro.task_type_enum = 16 LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop shop ON pro.workshop_id = shop.id AND shop.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process pss ON rep.process_id = pss.id AND pss.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tulink ON rep.team_id =tulink.team_id and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1
left join mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report itr on rep.task_process_id = itr.task_process_id and rep.number = itr.number and itr.bool_delete_enum = 0
WHERE rep.bool_delete_enum = 0 and rep.task_type_enum in (2, 16)
and (art.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%') or ass.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%'))
and itr.task_process_id is null
and pro.project_id = #{projectId}
AND rep.in_year_month_day_date >= date_format(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND rep.in_year_month_day_date <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and shop.id = #{workShopId}

SELECT sum(rep.quantity) inspectionQuantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report rep left JOIN mes_building_task_process pro ON rep.task_process_id = pro.id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report itr on rep.task_process_id = itr.task_process_id and rep.number = itr.number and itr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE rep.bool_delete_enum = 0
and itr.task_process_id is null
and itr.task_process_id is not null
and pro.project_id = #{projectId}
AND rep.in_year_month_day_date >= date_format(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND rep.in_year_month_day_date <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and pro.workshop_id = #{workShopId}

SELECT DISTINCT b.*, e.`name` inspectUserName, c.`name` project_name, c.id 'project.id', c.name 'project.name', c.short_name 'project.short_name', c.serial_number 'project.serial_number', mbp.`name` processName, tul.user_name 'teamName' FROM mes_building_qhse b LEFT JOIN sys_user e ON b.duty_id =e.id AND e.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project c ON b.project_id = c.id AND c.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON b.process_id=mbp.id AND mbp.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link tul ON b.team_id=tul.team_id AND tul.bool_delete_enum=FALSE and tul.bool_leader_enum = 1 WHERE b.bool_delete_enum=FALSE and b.id = #{qhseId}

SELECT qh.qhse_number qhseNumber, cp.short_name projectName, su.`name` inspectUser, su1.`name` teamName, pro.`name` processName, ccone.`name` levelOneName, cctwo.`name` levelTwoName, case when qh.task_type_enum = 2 THEN art.serial_number when qh.task_type_enum = 16 THEN ass.serial_number end serialNumber, qh.`status` status FROM mes_building_qhse qh left join contract_project cp on qh.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user su on qh.user_id = su.id and su.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user su1 on qh.duty_id = su1.id and su1.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_process pro on qh.process_id = pro.id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_quality_class_config ccone on qh.level_one_type = ccone.id and ccone.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_quality_class_config cctwo on qh.level_two_type = cctwo.id and cctwo.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_artifact art on qh.product_id = art.id and art.bool_delete_enum = 0 and qh.task_type_enum = 2 left join tech_assemble ass on qh.product_id = ass.id and ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 and qh.task_type_enum = 16 where qh.bool_delete_enum = 0 and qh.type & 9
and qh.create_time >= date_format(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')
and qh.`status` in
#{status}
